Package app.model

Class Photo

java.lang.Object
app.model.Photo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Photo extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a photo with its file path, caption, date of last modification, and associated tags. Tags are stored as a list Tag objects. The modification date is used to simulate the "date taken" for the photo. Supports adding and removing tags, enforcing tag uniqueness based on tag type rules. Photos are considered equal based on their file path. This class is serializable to allow persistence across sessions.
Author:
Toma Takamatsu

    • addTag

      public boolean addTag(Tag tag, boolean allowsMultiple)
      Attempts to add a tag to the photo. If allowsMultiple is false, ensures only one tag per type exists. If the tag already exists or is restricted by uniqueness, it is not added.
      Parameters:
      tag - the tag to add
      allowsMultiple - whether multiple tags of this type are allowed
      Returns:
      true if the tag was added, false otherwise
